name: Secret Ways
author: Captain Snail
description: Save locations for quick & easy navigation with a radial menu or hotkeys.
description_long: Adds 10 slots for saved locations. Saved locations can be quickly panned to with the radial menu or with dedicated hotkeys.[h2]Usage[/h2][list][*][b]Hold or tap T[/b] to open the radial menu; select an empty slot to bind a location, or an occupied one to pan there[*][b]Page Up[/b] enters bind mode; press one of the ten location keys to bind the current view.[*][b]Press U I O P J K L ; , .[/b] to jump to a saved view.[*][b]Manage your bound locations[/b] with the radial menu pinned [b](press T)[/b] - rename, delete, overwrite, or refresh the image preview[/list][h2]Hotkeys[/h2]All hotkeys are rebindable under [b]Options > Controls[/b], in a SECRET WAYS section below the base game's bindings.[h2]Requirements[/h2][b]Book of Hours will not load any DLL mod unless the GHIRBI gatekeeper mod is installed and enabled.[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3682369347]Subscribe to GHIRBI[/url], then enable it and Secret Ways in-game.[h2]Savegames and settings[/h2]Each playthrough keeps its own locations. Configuration lives in [i]secret_ways.json[/i] next to your saves, with thumbnails in [i]secret_ways_previews/[/i].
